warnings: released code samples in direct proportion to the minimization objective; formal reproduction preserves this behaviour

released GA checks the wall-clock limit only at generation boundaries and evaluates the final population after the loop; actual runtime can exceed the nominal paper limit and the overrun is reported per task
public Notebook ends calculate_lower_bound with 'lower_bound = processin'; the lower bound is unused by FFCBSPT/GA acceptance and is omitted
the Notebook report() redundantly reevaluates the final population after solution_time is frozen; these print-only evaluations do not affect the selected schedule and are omitted from this refactor

the Notebook uses NumPy's unseeded global RNG; each DBD task here uses its own locked RandomState seed so multiprocessing order cannot change results and the seed set matches the other three algorithms

released scheduler filters zero entries used for rectangular-array padding; this refactor stores explicit batches so a real batch released at minute 0 is scheduled instead of being mistaken for padding

aggregation.time_metrics_per_seed: pooled device moments over the complete 91-day window
aggregation.paper_table_standard_deviation: sample standard deviation across independent three-month random seeds
aggregation.utilization_primary: arithmetic mean of daily active-horizon utilization
aggregation.hourly: average devices per day; completion hour modulo 24
